verdict.rationale: Hightouch is a composable CDP with event collection and syncs to 300+ destinations, so consent capture and downstream enforcement is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about consent categories, opt-out handling, or consent-based filtering of syncs. Workspace permissions and approvals concern access control, not end-user consent, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically
